title: Accumulate half-open interval coverage across signed buckets
goal: Repair bucket_intervals(intervals, width). intervals is a list of integer pairs (start, end) representing half-open intervals [start, end); coordinates may be negative. width is a positive integer. Bucket k is [k*width, (k+1)*width), for every integer k including negative k. Return a list of (bucket_index, total_overlap_length) tuples sorted by bucket_index, omitting zero totals. Sum contributions from every interval independently, so duplicates and overlaps accumulate rather than being merged into a union. A zero-length interval contributes nothing. Raise ValueError for width <= 0 even if intervals is empty, or for any interval with end < start. Do not modify inputs. Empty intervals with positive width returns []. Preserve the signature. Integer calculations must be exact.
constraints: Do not add files, dependencies, or modify tests.
Keep bucket_intervals and its signature unchanged.
